answer: To create a fake identity, buy a unique real-world property deed (anchor) for $100 and spend 3 days registering it; also burn $20 in legal tender per identity, mail a $5 certificate, and pay a $2 processing fee. The anchor is one-per-identity, checked against a public registry. Renting the anchor costs $50/day but risks exposure. One fake identity costs $127 and 3 days; 100 cost $12,700 and 300 days. The grove of identities requires a costly oasis of real-world assets. The comet of regulation makes duplication hard.
